subject: rename redisOp to serverOp (#181)
reason: The change only renames the typedef redisOp to serverOp in src/server.h and updates the three references in src/server.c (serverOpArrayAppend, serverOpArrayFree, propagatePendingCommands). A C typedef rename is purely a compile-time identifier change: struct layout, sizeof, allocation, and all logic are identical, so no command reply, propagation, replication, or persistence behaviour can differ. It is a pure refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
